home.title: Build Apps from Metadata
home.description: A production-grade metadata-driven application runtime that dynamically generates forms, tables, dashboards, and workflows from JSON configuration. Handles edge cases gracefully without breaking.

features.dynamicDesc: Automatically render forms, tables, and dashboards from configuration without hardcoding UI components.
features.errorDesc: Gracefully handles missing fields, invalid values, unknown components, and inconsistent schemas.
features.fullstackDesc: Complete solution with frontend renderers, backend APIs, database schema generation, and authentication.
